randomness.mirror_rotate: only entire compatible physical precinct with preserved board coordinates and approach; no unchecked rotation of combat data
randomness.event_site_permutation: A/B/C may host other compatible ordinary cards; service props exist only where explicitly bound; D may host a nonvariant fourth card
randomness.normal_encounters: three distinct out of four; two variant candidates count as alternatives of one slot

variant_contract.common_board: choose from intersection of both encounters allowed_board_variants and region board_ids; not merely default board IDs

scene_binding_rules.ordinary: instantiate visible scene props and any receipt-owning NPC at assigned anchor; secondary objects reachable without extra battle; all alternative props share one event receipt
scene_binding_rules.scout: A with real B2 detail; after B2 reveal PRIMARY disabled, remaining budget-legal option or PASS
scene_binding_rules.workbench: B with actual artisan and bench; original FIELD-CO-1.0 inputs, output, capacity and transaction; no free crafting when card absent
scene_binding_rules.variant: D with guide and sign ropes before B1; one locked board for both variants
scene_binding_rules.EV04: two distinct bell landmarks and both rubbing interactions reachable from chosen anchor without an additional uncleared battle; share one receipt; no pre-made second rubbing substituted for player action
scene_binding_rules.EV08: requires_real_unstarted_encounter_with_EN04_at_B2 and safe observation binding; exclude if no actor exists or already defeated; no extra enemy spawned
scene_binding_rules.EV17: requires real present eligible recruit for personal scene; if absent, show ordinary scene aftermath without fabricated speaker, no reroll or new reward; do not tailor departure draw to party
scene_binding_rules.EV23: physical repeating conveyor prop at event anchor, no per_cycle material generation
scene_binding_rules.EV27: ST-303 required even if the physical plaque prop exists; no pretruth text display

receiver_rules.LOCAL: real witness/counterparty at event anchor; no remote confirmation
receiver_rules.ESCORT: cleared safe return to I then actual safe station acceptance; one legal reserve human leaves party or whole party returns; no factor on just selecting
receiver_rules.RETURN: whole party follows cleared safe route to I then safe extraction and clinic acceptance; no unseen-region completion
receiver_rules.CARGO: reserve two unspent material budget units and actual safe town acceptance; arrival at I alone not completion
receiver_rules.departure_without_completion: original pending/custody rules; no invented success or harm receipt
receiver_rules.cross_region: no return to prior region; display unresolved custody and actual leave consequences before committing exit

reward_binding.supply: S once per region independent of event; X camp once only nonfinal boundary; I only entry/extraction not extra free heal
reward_binding.goal: 16 copper +2 crystal credit at actual goal success, bank only on safe run end
reward_binding.elite: 8 copper +2 crystal only actual L victory; max one per region
reward_binding.events: one receipt per event instance; alternative props never have separate reward receipts
reward_binding.budget_planning: max debit per resource over enabled mutually exclusive options at each site; sum across simultaneously visitable sites; validate every possible region path, not all eight regions summed nor one chosen path only
reward_binding.if_budget_exceeded: reject plan or explicitly disable nonreserved reward options before departure; free PASS remains; no silent cap expansion
reward_binding.humanity_cargo: two reserved material units unavailable to ordinary claims; no release for farming same run
reward_binding.witness_scope: one budget-feasible option per event plus selected goal materials, not proof all options can pay simultaneously or a required player sequence
